notes: Identity confirmed on four signals: the official Yashoda URL encodes the branch and department (/doctor/hitech-city/general-medicine/) and the result title reads 'Best Physician in Hyderabad | Dr. Dilip Nandamuri'; a second Yashoda page title reads 'Dr. Dilip Nandamuri | Sr. Consultant Physician & Diabetologist'. Name + specialty (internal medicine/diabetology) + hospital + Hitec City branch + city all match the brief. CLINICAL DIRECTOR: an exact-phrase query for '"Dilip Nandamuri" "Clinical Director"' returned the Yashoda Hitec City profile as its top result and the summary described him as 'Consultant Physician & Diabetologist in the Department of Internal Medicine and Clinical Director' - wording that matches the brief's own title. Recorded in verified_role and hni_signals, but flagged here because I could not open the page to see the phrase in situ (WebFetch blocked). NO email and NO phone recorded: nothing institutional surfaced; the JustDial listing that appeared is a call-tracking proxy and was rejected per section 4, as were the aggregator 'contact number' pages (Lybrate, 365Doctor, DocMitra). URL VARIANT TO CHECK: two spellings of the branch segment came back verbatim across two searches - '/doctor/hitech-city/general-medicine/dr-dileep-nandamuri/' and '/doctor/hitec-city/general-medicine/dr-dileep-nandamuri/'. I recorded the first as returned; one is likely a redirect to the other. Note also that the Yashoda slug spells the name 'dr-dileep-nandamuri' while every page title spells it 'Dilip'. STALE/OTHER AFFILIATION TO CHECK: starhospitals.in carries a 'Dr. Dilip Nandamuri | Consultant Physician and Diabetologist' profile. Same name and same specialty in the same city, and the Yashoda snippet says he joined Hitec City in August 2022, so this is plausibly a prior post - but I could not confirm it is the same person, so it is filed under other_profiles only and is NOT counted toward the confidence band. Experience is inconsistent across Yashoda's own snippets ('close to a decade' in one, 'over 20 years' in another); the brief says 21 years, so I recorded ~20 years and flagged the discrepancy. Band is Medium not High: yashodahospitals.com is the only qualifying official domain, and several pages on one domain is still one domain. No LinkedIn, ORCID or Google Scholar profile surfaced (one query spent; absence is the normal result for this cohort) despite genuine publication and trial activity.
